_about: The emission surface of the gateway's `agent` channel at v2026.9.36: every site that emits an agent event (stream, phase, data keys), the frames the gateway itself fabricates or rewrites on that channel, and the chat content-part types its display projection produces. DERIVED from the whole upstream program by scripts/lib/derive-agent-emissions.mjs, starting from src/infra/agent-events.ts; the bulky audit lists of its completeness claim are left out (forwards, completeness.byName, completeness.homonymDeclarations, completeness.unresolvedIdentifiers, scope.testExclusion.excludedFilesMentioningFamily, scope.testExclusion.reincludedByImportGuard, scope.unresolvedCodeImports). Do not edit by hand: re-run scripts/vendor-protocol.mjs.
